description: This file defines an interface `ProvisioningCriteriaWritePlatformService` with methods for creating, updating, and deleting provisioning criteria within the Fineract provisioning service.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining service methods for managing provisioning criteria within the provisioning system.

methods.name: createProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Creates a new provisioning criteria based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Updates an existing provisioning criteria identified by categoryId using the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteProvisioningCriteria
methods.description: Deletes an existing provisioning criteria identified by entryId.
